Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Color.Transparent,
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        gblAppColors.Error,
        gblAppColors.ApprovalClusterStates.InProgress
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",
        gblEnvironmentName = "Prod"
    ),
    false,
    true
)

If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Icon.Information,
    If(
        cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
        Icon.Blocked,
        "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        Icon.Lock,
        Icon.Information
    )
)

If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    "",
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        "Active"
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",
        gblEnvironmentName = "Prod"
    ),
    false,
    true
)

Rules.InvariantScript: "Currently recalculating this countries projects Costs and standard assumed Milestone dates."

!IsEmpty(
    Filter(
        'Fabric Sync Jobs',
        'Regarding Object' = ThisItem,
        'Job Type'.Name = "Portfolio Milestone Assumptions changed",
        'Job Status' in [
            'Job States'.'In Delay',
            'Job States'.'In Progress',
            'Job States'.Importing
        ]
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
!IsEmpty(
    Filter(
        'Fabric Sync Jobs',
        'Regarding Object' = gblRecordSelectedProject,
        'Job Type'.Name = "Project Milestones changed",
        'Job Status' in [
            'Job States'.'In Progress',
            'Job States'.Importing
        ]
    )
)
